svg.title: Server <-> Client Sequence Diagram (Linux: Unix Domain Sockets)

g.text: Server <-> Client Sequence Diagram (Linux: Unix Domain Sockets)
The QNX Dispatch counterpart is in server_client_sequence_qnx.puml.
Both platforms expose the same public API.
The listener endpoint callback fires on the engine thread:
UnixDomainServer accepts the connection and creates its own
ServerConnection, using the engine directly - not the abstract
ConnectCallback(connection) invoked; server app returns UserData,
Delivers the message over the connected socket
The server detects the disconnect and tears
